The Reeve's name
settings.help: What Legato calls the Reeve on this instance: in the sidebar, its conversation, approvals, notifications and the TUI, and in its own prompt. "the Reeve" when empty.
settings.description: What Legato calls the Reeve on this instance: in the sidebar, its conversation, approvals, notifications and the TUI, and in its own prompt. "the Reeve" when empty.

settings.title: The Reeve's agent tool
settings.help: claude-code, codex or chimera; the default agent tool when empty.
settings.description: claude-code, codex or chimera; the default agent tool when empty.

settings.title: Suspend the Reeve after
settings.help: How long a session may be idle before its agent is stopped; the next message resumes it. 2h when empty.
settings.description: How long a session may be idle before its agent is stopped; the next message resumes it. 2h when empty.

settings.title: What a change needs
settings.help: auto (runs at once, no approval asked), approve (a tap), signed (an enrolled device) or verified (signed, with a fingerprint or a PIN). One of the Reeve's own rules: changed only with a signature, though making it stricter needs none.
settings.description: auto (runs at once, no approval asked), approve (a tap), signed (an enrolled device) or verified (signed, with a fingerprint or a PIN). One of the Reeve's own rules: changed only with a signature, though making it stricter needs none.

settings.title: What a risky change needs
settings.help: default (signed once a device is enrolled, else approve), approve, signed or verified; or auto, which runs risky changes (restarts, agents stopped, settings that choose what runs on this machine) at once with no approval asked. One of the Reeve's own rules.
settings.description: default (signed once a device is enrolled, else approve), approve, signed or verified; or auto, which runs risky changes (restarts, agents stopped, settings that choose what runs on this machine) at once with no approval asked. One of the Reeve's own rules.

settings.title: Host operations
settings.help: Offer the Reeve a shell, file edits and systemd services on this machine, each as a change you approve. One of the Reeve's own rules.
settings.description: Offer the Reeve a shell, file edits and systemd services on this machine, each as a change you approve. One of the Reeve's own rules.

settings.title: Run host operations without asking
settings.help: On, the Reeve's shell commands, file edits and service actions run at once, with no approval asked: it can then run any command as your user on this machine. Each is still audited. Commands as root still need a verified approval. Off by default; one of the Reeve's own rules: turning it on needs a signature, turning it off never does.
settings.description: On, the Reeve's shell commands, file edits and service actions run at once, with no approval asked: it can then run any command as your user on this machine. Each is still audited. Commands as root still need a verified approval. Off by default; one of the Reeve's own rules: turning it on needs a signature, turning it off never does.

settings.title: Host command timeout
settings.help: How long one host command may run. 10m when empty.
settings.description: How long one host command may run. 10m when empty.

settings.title: Host command output (bytes)
settings.help: How much of a host command's output the Reeve is given; the rest is kept in a file it can read. 65536 when 0.
settings.description: How much of a host command's output the Reeve is given; the rest is kept in a file it can read. 65536 when 0.

settings.title: When another Reeve messages
settings.help: With no session running: start one (start, the default), ask a person first (ask), or refuse. One of the Reeve's own rules.
settings.description: With no session running: start one (start, the default), ask a person first (ask), or refuse. One of the Reeve's own rules.

settings.title: The Reeve's voice
settings.help: Lets the Reeve speak out loud on this machine's speakers. Sessions started after it is turned on are offered the speak tool; turning it off mutes the Reeve at once.
settings.description: Lets the Reeve speak out loud on this machine's speakers. Sessions started after it is turned on are offered the speak tool; turning it off mutes the Reeve at once.

settings.title: Voice command
settings.help: Makes a line's audio: run as <command> "<text>" <out-file>, it writes an audio file to <out-file>. A script such as reeve-say.sh, or one for Piper.
settings.description: Makes a line's audio: run as <command> "<text>" <out-file>, it writes an audio file to <out-file>. A script such as reeve-say.sh, or one for Piper.

settings.title: Voice credential
settings.help: A credential Legato gives the voice command, as elevenlabs. Empty for a local voice.
settings.description: A credential Legato gives the voice command, as elevenlabs. Empty for a local voice.

settings.title: Voice credential variable
settings.help: The variable the command finds the credential in. The credential's name in capitals with _API_KEY when empty (ELEVENLABS_API_KEY).
settings.description: The variable the command finds the credential in. The credential's name in capitals with _API_KEY when empty (ELEVENLABS_API_KEY).

settings.title: Pause that ends a spoken turn
settings.help: How long you stay quiet before what you said is sent to the Reeve, from 0.3s to 2s. 1s when empty.
settings.description: How long you stay quiet before what you said is sent to the Reeve, from 0.3s to 2s. 1s when empty.

settings.title: Listen for a reply for
settings.help: How long the voice listens for your reply after the Reeve has spoken. 6s when empty; 0s for a single turn.
settings.description: How long the voice listens for your reply after the Reeve has spoken. 6s when empty; 0s for a single turn.

settings.title: Words as you speak
settings.help: Show the words so far while you speak, by transcribing about once a second. Turn it off when Whisper runs on a CPU, or is shared with Home Assistant.
settings.description: Show the words so far while you speak, by transcribing about once a second. Turn it off when Whisper runs on a CPU, or is shared with Home Assistant.

settings.title: Quiet hours
settings.help: No line plays on this machine's speakers then, as 22:00-07:00 in its local time; the Reeve replies in writing instead. A reply to something you said to it still plays on your device. Empty for none.
settings.description: No line plays on this machine's speakers then, as 22:00-07:00 in its local time; the Reeve replies in writing instead. A reply to something you said to it still plays on your device. Empty for none.

settings.title: Voice player
settings.help: Plays a line's audio file, named after it. pw-play, else ffplay, when empty.
settings.description: Plays a line's audio file, named after it. pw-play, else ffplay, when empty.

settings.title: Agent idle before the Reeve is told
settings.help: How long an agent the Reeve watches must stay idle, or busy only in the background, before the Reeve is told, so brief pauses do not wake it. 30s when empty.
settings.description: How long an agent the Reeve watches must stay idle, or busy only in the background, before the Reeve is told, so brief pauses do not wake it. 30s when empty.

settings.title: Watch the agents the Reeve starts
settings.help: Watch every agent the Reeve starts or messages, so it is told when one waits, goes idle, adds a note, opens a pull request or exits.
settings.description: Watch every agent the Reeve starts or messages, so it is told when one waits, goes idle, adds a note, opens a pull request or exits.

settings.title: Wake the Reeve for its agents
settings.help: When an agent the Reeve watches needs it and no session is running, start or resume one to tell it. Off, the news waits for the next session. On costs tokens while you are away.
settings.description: When an agent the Reeve watches needs it and no session is running, start or resume one to tell it. Off, the news waits for the next session. On costs tokens while you are away.

settings.title: Burnlite projects
settings.help: The projects searched for import; none is every project.
settings.description: The projects searched for import; none is every project.
